title: Kangana Ranaut Fires Back at Baba Ramdev Over 'Generation Gutter' Criticism
excerpt: BJP MP accuses yoga guru of crossing 'every boundary of decency' as their war of words intensifies over her controversial remarks about Gen Z protesters.
body:
• Kangana Ranaut has accused Baba Ramdev of crossing "every boundary of decency" with his remarks about women, escalating their public feud
  • The dispute stems from Ramdev calling Ranaut's "Generation Gutter" label for Gen Z protesters a sign of a "corrupted mind"
  • Ranaut hit back on Instagram, referencing Patanjali's Supreme Court reprimand for misleading advertising claims
  • The BJP MP also targeted Bollywood figures Sonu Sood, Taapsee Pannu, Rakhi Sawant, and Ashutosh Rana who had criticized her

BJP MP and actor Kangana Ranaut has widened her public feud with yoga guru Baba Ramdev, accusing him of crossing "every boundary of decency" in his comments about women. The escalation follows Ramdev's sharp criticism of Ranaut's controversial "Generation Gutter" remarks about Gen Z protesters.

The "Generation Gutter" Controversy

The dispute traces back to late July, when Ranaut used the phrase "Generation Gutter" on Instagram while criticizing protesters who had gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak. She described protest videos as "puke-inducing," questioned the upbringing of participants, and accused sections of young women of embracing "Westernised attitudes" without accountability.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=bkbAI8x1GPs

"Never in my life have I seen so much ugliness in one place," Ranaut wrote on Instagram. She referred to the protesters as members of the "Cockroach Janata Party," or CJP — the student-led group that had organized the demonstrations against alleged NEET irregularities.

The remarks triggered nationwide backlash. Student groups burned her effigy in Jabalpur, a legal case was filed against her in Agra, and several entertainment industry figures publicly condemned her comments. Actor Sonu Sood called the remarks "shameful," while Taapsee Pannu and Ashutosh Rana also weighed in with pointed criticism of the Mandi MP.

Ramdev Calls It a "Corrupted Mind"

Baba Ramdev entered the fray around August 19, publicly questioning Ranaut's background and characterizing her statements as symptomatic of deeper problems.

"What was her childhood like? What was her youth like? What were her past accomplishments like?" Ramdev told reporters. "I don't want to talk about such people. Calling the youth 'generation gutter' is a sign of a corrupted mind."

He urged the BJP to take note of her comments, adding his voice to the growing chorus of public figures who had criticized the actor-turned-politician.

Kangana's Instagram Counterattack

Ranaut responded through her Instagram Stories with a pointed personal attack, referencing Ramdev's 2024 legal troubles when the Supreme Court reprimanded Patanjali Ayurved for misleading advertising claims about its health products.

"Baba ji don't daydream about my jawani or bedroom. At least I never got scolded by the Supreme Court for false/fraud efficacy claims. So don't give me character lessons. My character is far better than yours — no fraud detected here."

— Kangana Ranaut, via Instagram Stories

Wider Targets at Delhi Airport

Speaking to reporters at Delhi Airport on August 25, Ranaut extended her criticism beyond Ramdev, naming actors Ashutosh Rana, Sonu Sood, Rakhi Sawant, and Taapsee Pannu.

"Every day, I see people like Ashutosh Rana — who says I bark like a dog — or the likes of Sonu Sood," she said. "Then there are people like Rakhi Sawant, who make all sorts of remarks about my character, and Taapsee Pannu, who insults my parents, my upbringing, and my background."

She dismissed her critics collectively: "If you haven't achieved even one per cent of the success I have in life, I am not going to listen to you. These are all failed, completely irrelevant people who constantly hurl abuse at me just to get media attention."

"As for Baba Ramdev, he has crossed every boundary of decency. The kind of comments he has made about a woman have shamed society. He really needs to reflect on his perspective regarding women."

— Kangana Ranaut, at Delhi Airport

No Signs of Cooling

The public feud shows no signs of abating. A court in Agra is hearing the legal case filed against Ranaut over her original "Generation Gutter" remarks. The CJP-led protests over the NEET paper leak had ended after the government agreed to several demands, including compensation for affected students and withdrawal of FIRs against protesters — but the political fallout continues.

Ranaut, who represents Mandi in Himachal Pradesh, has a long history of public confrontations with entertainment industry figures and has increasingly used her BJP platform to weigh in on cultural and generational debates. Both she and Ramdev remain widely followed figures across the Indian diaspora, where the clash over generational values and public discourse has drawn significant attention on social media.
